reading.note: Added by hand after the computed fields above (Opus review, 2026-10-27).
reading.steps: Controller used fewer model steps in 10/12 units and more in 0. Between identical treatments (both vs controller) the split was 6/4, so per-unit step counts are noisy, but a 10-0 split in one direction is not explained by that spread. The size of the saving is not measured: 'none' hit the 20-step cap in 7/12 runs, so its median of 20 is the cap. In those runs Qwen had usually fixed the bug and kept going; the controller's main effect looks like letting it stop (committed 12/12 vs 10/12).
reading.executor_actions: Model tool calls were lower in 11/12 units (identical-treatment splits 2/7 and 5/4). The 138 vs 193 executor-action total includes the controller's 25 runtime test runs.
reading.wall_time: Not established. Controller was faster in 8/12 units, which is the same split as guard vs none, an identical treatment (8/12, median 15 s).
reading.next: Treat the step and action saving as a hypothesis for a preregistered test on tasks Qwen does not solve unaided, with a step cap high enough that the unaided arm is not censored.
